The rating is INTEGER (1–5), so "4.5 or higher" means rating = 5. The time column has two formats, but both contain "2019" for year 2019. Let me aggregate high-rating reviews per business for 2019.

{"content":"SELECT gmap_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM review
WHERE rating >= 4.5 AND time LIKE '%2019%'
GROUP BY gmap_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;","path":"runs_tmp/top.sql"}
